provenance.method: targets set from qpos0 of each composed model, joint couplings evaluated from their polynomials, ankles and declared joints solved until the feet are level and at equal height, root lowered to the floor clearance; model parameters are not changed

standing.description: Upright, feet flat, arms just clear of the thorax. The reference start, as in 0.2.4.
standing.source: qpos0 with the couplings evaluated; shoulder elevation is a clearance value, not a measured arm posture

ready.description: Slightly flexed athletic stance, feet apart. Twice the balance margin of standing, room to move in any direction.
ready.source: chosen: hip, knee and trunk values with the centre of mass mid-foot; no measured general ready stance was found

staggered.description: Right foot ahead, both feet flat. Breaks the symmetry of standing for gait and direction changes.
staggered.source: chosen: hip angles inside the peak range of walking (Winiarski et al. 2019), feet kept flat, not a gait event

seat_off.description: Thighs near horizontal, as at the moment of leaving a chair. A sit-to-stand start.
seat_off.source: hip 93.3, knee 82.7 deg at seat-off (Kinoshita et al. 2015); pelvis pitch set so that the ankle comes near their 9.0 deg

squat.description: Same joint depth as seat_off with the centre of mass over the feet. A loaded start that stays on its feet longer.
squat.source: hip and knee as seat_off (Kinoshita et al. 2015); pelvis pitch solved for balance, so the ankle is a result

arms_at_side.description: Arm hanging, elbow slightly flexed, forearm neutral, relaxed hand. The default start of the arm models.
arms_at_side.source: hand from Lee and Jung 2010; elbow chosen off its stop; shoulder elevation is a clearance value

forearm_raised.description: Upper arm down, forearm raised, relaxed hand. Starts near the middle of the elbow range.
forearm_raised.source: elbow at the middle of the functional arc of Morrey et al. 1981, forearm neutral; hand from Lee and Jung 2010

reach.description: Upper arm forward, elbow flexed, hand in front of the chest. Start for reaching and manipulation tasks.
reach.source: chosen inside the shoulder and elbow ranges of seated daily tasks (Inagaki et al. 2025); hand from Lee and Jung 2010

relaxed.description: Resting hand with flexed fingers and an extended wrist. The default start of the hand models.
relaxed.source: wrist and finger flexion from Lee and Jung 2010; thumb CMC and finger abduction chosen

open.description: Fingers off their extension stops, thumb abducted, relaxed wrist. Start for reaching to grasp.
open.source: chosen: small flexion values off the joint limits; wrist from Lee and Jung 2010
